messages:
sarah_sales: Hey team — Prospect EdgeFarm is ready to start private POC next week. Need a short preflight checklist for their on-prem nodes and access (GPU driver / CUDA / k8s / network / KMS). Can Field Eng + SRE confirm what's required? cc @eli_fieldeng @jordan_sre :wave:

eli_fieldeng: Quick q — do we have node SKUs + OS + whether it's air-gapped? Also who will run the install (customer or our field eng)?

jordan_sre: Also need to know if there's a corporate proxy, egress restrictions, and whether images can be pulled from our registry. We typically need outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai (443) for licensing/telemetry unless it's fully air-gapped.

sarah_sales: Customer responded:
- Nodes: 3 x NVIDIA A100 80GB
- OS: Ubuntu 22.04
- Kernel: 5.15.0-58-generic
- K8s: 1.25.4
- No corporate proxy, private registry in same VPC, Vault for KMS, not air-gapped
- Installer: customer's infra team with remote guidance

eli_fieldeng: OK looks good. Main checklist items:
- NVIDIA driver >=525 (we recommend 525+ or the distro's recommended driver)
- CUDA toolkit 11.8 or 12.x supported; match container images
- ensure nvidia modules loaded and nvidia-smi ok
- kubelet/kubeadm versions compatible (1.25 is supported)
- kernel headers installed for driver build if they need to compile
- container runtime: containerd >=1.6 or Docker 20.10 (we prefer containerd)
- cgroup v1/v2 note: we support both but containerd setup needs cgroup config

eli_fieldeng: Quick commands for them to run and paste back:
```
# on each node
uname -r
nvidia-smi
modinfo nvidia | head -n 5
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
kubectl get nodes -o wide
crictl info || docker info
```

jordan_sre: Networking notes:
- Allow outbound 443 to api.redwood.ai for image pulls (unless using fully private image mirror)
- Open ports between nodes for kube (6443 control plane if needed, node ports for kube-proxy, etc.)
- If Vault is external, ensure TLS and service account creds available; we'll need a KMS config with certs/keys

sarah_sales: Customer will run the commands and collect outputs. They asked about whether we need a Hosted API key for test traffic vs Dedicated pool access — can we give them a short test key for smoke tests? :thinking:

eli_fieldeng: We can provide a short-lived hosted API key for smoke tests (no production data). For Dedicated/private POC we prefer they test against local images/endpoints. I'll prepare a small test manifest and a config snippet for KMS.

deploy-bot: Install job created: job_id=IF-9043, assignee=@eli_fieldeng, eta=Thu 09:00 UTC :gear:

sarah_sales: Thanks folks — I'll collect the outputs and ping when they're ready. :thumbsup:
